shortDescription: Manages volumes on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the volume. Either name or UUID must be present to change an existing volume.

options.name: revert
options.description: UUID of the snapshot to revert the volume to. This must be the most recent snapshot of the volume. For root volumes: the respective server must be shut down. For non-root volumes: the volume to be reverted must be detached

options.name: servers
options.description: UUIDs of the servers this volume is attached to. Set this to C([]) to detach the volume. Currently a volume can only be attached to a single server. The aliases C(server_uuids) and C(server_uuid) are deprecated and will be removed in version 3.0.0 of this collection.

options.name: size_gb
options.description: Size of the volume in GB.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags associated with the volume. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the volume. Cannot be changed after creating the volume. Defaults to C(ssd) on volume creation.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the volume. Either name or UUID must be present to change an existing volume.

options.name: zone
options.description: Zone in which the volume resides (e.g. C(lpg1) or C(rma1)). Cannot be changed after creating the volume. Defaults to the project default zone.
